148: def _has_search_intent(subquestion: str) -> bool:
149:     lowered = subquestion.lower()
150:     return any(token.lower() in lowered for token in _SEARCH_TOKENS)
151: 
152: 
153: def _is_valid_subquestion(subquestion: Any) -> bool:
154:     return (
155:         isinstance(subquestion, str)
156:         and len(subquestion.strip()) >= 8
157:         and bool(_WORD_RE.search(subquestion))
158:     )
159: 
160: 
161: def _default_search_subquestion(language: str) -> str:
162:     if language == "zh":
163:         return "\u67e5\u627e\u5e76\u6838\u5b9e\u8be5\u95ee\u9898\u7684\u6743\u5a01 web \u8d44\u6599\u3002"
164:     return "Search the web for authoritative sources on the research question."
165: 
166: 
167: def _normalize_plan(
168:     data: Dict[str, Any], question: str, error: Optional[str] = None
169: ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
170:     """Coerce a raw planner dict into a valid, search-mandated plan."""
171:     language = data.get("target_language")
172:     if language not in ("en", "zh"):
173:         language = detect_language(question)
174: 
175:     raw_subs = data.get("subquestions")
176:     if not isinstance(raw_subs, list):
177:         raw_subs = []
178:     subquestions: List[str] = [s.strip() for s in raw_subs if _is_valid_subquestion(s)]
179: 
180:     expected = data.get("expected_answer_type")
181:     if not isinstance(expected, str) or not expected.strip():
182:         expected = "short_fact"
183: 
184:     must_search = bool(data.get("must_search", True))
185:     if expected in _FACT_SEEKING_TYPES:
186:         must_search = True
187: 
188:     if must_search and not any(_has_search_intent(s) for s in subquestions):
189:         subquestions.append(_default_search_subquestion(language))
190:     if not subquestions:
191:         subquestions = [_default_search_subquestion(language)]
192:         must_search = True
193: 
194:     plan: Dict[str, Any] = {
195:         "target_language": language,
196:         "subquestions": subquestions,
197:         "expected_answer_type": expected,
198:         "must_search": must_search,
199:     }
200:     if isinstance(data.get("notes"), str) and data["notes"].strip():
201:         plan["notes"] = data["notes"]
202:     if error:
203:         plan["error"] = error
204:     return plan
205: 
206: 
207: def _run_awaitable(awaitable: Any) -> Any:
208:     """Run a coroutine from sync code, even if an event loop is already running."""
209:     try:
210:         asyncio.get_running_loop()
211:     except RuntimeError:
212:         return asyncio.run(awaitable)
213:     with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
214:         return pool.submit(asyncio.run, awaitable).result()
215: 
216: 
217: def _call_tool(fn: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
218:     """Call an injected tool method that may be sync or async."""
219:     result = fn(*args, **kwargs)
220:     if inspect.isawaitable(result):
221:         return _run_awaitable(result)
222:     return result
223: 
224: 
225: def _normalize_search_results(raw: Any) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
226:     """Coerce a search-tool response into a list of {url,title,snippet} dicts."""
227:     if isinstance(raw, dict):
228:         for key in ("organic", "results", "items", "data", "hits"):
229:             if isinstance(raw.get(key), list):
230:                 raw = raw[key]
231:                 break
232:         else:
233:             raw = [raw]
234:     if not isinstance(raw, (list, tuple)):
235:         return []
236:     results: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
237:     for item in raw:
238:         if not isinstance(item, dict):
239:             continue
240:         url = item.get("url") or item.get("link")
241:         if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
242:             continue
243:         snippet = item.get("snippet") or item.get("description") or item.get("text") or ""
244:         results.append(
245:             {
246:                 "url": url,
247:                 "title": str(item.get("title") or ""),
248:                 "snippet": str(snippet),
249:             }
250:         )
251:     return results
252: 
253: 
254: def _as_snippets(value: Any) -> List[str]:
255:     """Flatten an arbitrary browse return value into non-empty snippet strings."""
256:     out: List[str] = []
257:     if isinstance(value, str):
258:         if value.strip():
259:             out.append(value.strip())
260:     elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
261:         for item in value:
262:             out.extend(_as_snippets(item))
263:     elif isinstance(value, dict):
264:         for item in value.values():
265:             out.extend(_as_snippets(item))
266:     return out

269: class ResearchAgent:
270:     """Deep research agent with explicit (injected) dependencies.
271: 
272:     ``__init__`` performs no network or filesystem I/O: it only stores the
273:     injected clients/tools and configuration on the instance.
274:     """
275: 
276:     def __init__(
277:         self,
278:         research_llm: Any,
279:         browsing_llm: Any,
280:         search_tool: Any,
281:         browsing_agent: Any,
282:         max_research_time_s: float = DEFAULT_MAX_RESEARCH_TIME_S,
283:         must_use_search: bool = True,
284:         search_top_k: int = DEFAULT_SEARCH_TOP_K,
285:     ) -> None:
286:         # Injected dependencies (GPT-4.1 research client, GPT-4.1-mini browsing
287:         # client, SearchEngineTool instance, BrowsingAgent instance).
288:         self.research_llm = research_llm
289:         self.browsing_llm = browsing_llm
290:         self.search_tool = search_tool
291:         self.browsing_agent = browsing_agent
292: 
293:         self.research_model_name = _resolve_model_name(research_llm, GPT41_BACKBONE)
294:         self.browsing_model_name = _resolve_model_name(browsing_llm, GPT41_MINI_BACKBONE)
295: 
296:         self.max_research_time_s = max_research_time_s
297:         self.must_use_search = must_use_search
298:         self.search_top_k = search_top_k
299: 
300:     # -- planning ---------------------------------------------------------
301: 
302:     def _invoke_planner(self, question: str, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> str:
303:         """Ask the GPT-4.1 backbone for a JSON-only research plan (raw text)."""
304:         user_block = question
305:         if metadata:
306:             user_block = f"{question}\n\nmetadata: {json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False)}"
307:         messages = [
308:             {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT_RESEARCH_CORE},
309:             {"role": "user", "content": user_block},
310:         ]
311:         response = self.research_llm.get_chat_completion_sync(
312:             messages=messages, temperature=0.2, max_tokens=2000
313:         )
314:         return _extract_content(response)
315: 
316:     def _plan_research(
317:         self, question: str, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
318:     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
319:         """Decompose ``question`` into a structured, search-mandated plan."""
320:         try:
321:             raw = self._invoke_planner(question, metadata)
322:         except Exception as exc:  # missing client method, network error, etc.
323:             return _normalize_plan({}, question, error=f"planner call failed: {exc}")
324: 
325:         try:
326:             data = json.loads(_strip_json(raw))
327:             if not isinstance(data, dict):
328:                 raise ValueError("planner output is not a JSON object")
329:         except Exception as exc:
330:             return _normalize_plan({}, question, error=f"invalid planner JSON: {exc}")
331:         return _normalize_plan(data, question)
332: 
333:     # -- evidence acquisition --------------------------------------------
334: 
335:     def _invoke_browse(self, url: str, query: str, language: str) -> Any:
336:         """Call the browsing agent, adapting to ``browse`` or ``run`` signatures."""
337:         browse = getattr(self.browsing_agent, "browse", None)
338:         if callable(browse):
339:             try:
340:                 return _call_tool(browse, url, query, language)
341:             except TypeError:
342:                 # Some browsing agents expose browse(url, query) only.
343:                 return _call_tool(browse, url, query)
344:         run = getattr(self.browsing_agent, "run", None)
345:         if callable(run):
346:             return _call_tool(run, [{"url": url, "query": query}], query)
347:         return None
348: 
349:     def _gather_evidence(
350:         self, plan: Dict[str, Any], steps: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None
351:     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
352:         """Search + browse each sub-question, honouring the wall-clock budget."""
353:         if steps is None:
354:             steps = []
355:         subquestions = plan.get("subquestions") or []
356:         language = plan.get("target_language") or "en"
357:         budget = self.max_research_time_s
358:         top_k = max(1, int(self.search_top_k))
359: 
360:         start = time.time()
361:         items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
362:         search_calls = 0
363:         browse_calls = 0
364:         search_successes = 0
365:         truncated = False
366: 
367:         def timed_out() -> bool:
368:             return budget is not None and (time.time() - start) > budget
369: 
370:         for subquestion in subquestions:
371:             if timed_out():
372:                 truncated = True
373:                 break
374:             query = (subquestion or "").strip()
375:             if not query:
376:                 continue
377: 
378:             steps.append({"t": time.time(), "action": "search", "detail": query})
379:             search_calls += 1
380:             try:
381:                 raw = _call_tool(self.search_tool.search, query)
382:             except Exception:
383:                 raw = None
384:             results = _normalize_search_results(raw)
385:             if results:
386:                 search_successes += 1
387: 
388:             for result in results[:top_k]:
389:                 if timed_out():
390:                     truncated = True
391:                     break
392:                 url = result["url"]
393:                 steps.append({"t": time.time(), "action": "browse", "detail": url})
394:                 browse_calls += 1
395:                 try:
396:                     browsed = self._invoke_browse(url, query, language)
397:                 except Exception:
398:                     browsed = None
399: 
400:                 snippets = _as_snippets(browsed)
401:                 if not snippets and result["snippet"]:
402:                     snippets = [result["snippet"]]
403: 
404:                 item = items.get(url)
405:                 if item is None:
406:                     item = {
407:                         "url": url,
408:                         "title": result["title"],
409:                         "language": language,
410:                         "snippets": [],
411:                         "supporting_subquestions": [],
412:                     }
413:                     items[url] = item
414:                 for snippet in snippets:
415:                     if snippet and snippet not in item["snippets"]:
416:                         item["snippets"].append(snippet)
417:                 if query not in item["supporting_subquestions"]:
418:                     item["supporting_subquestions"].append(query)
419: 
420:             if truncated:
421:                 break
422: 
423:         return {
424:             "items": list(items.values()),
425:             "truncated": truncated,
426:             "search_calls": search_calls,
427:             "browse_calls": browse_calls,
428:             "search_successes": search_successes,
429:             "steps": steps,
430:         }
431: 
432:     # -- synthesis --------------------------------------------------------
433: 
434:     def _synthesize_answer(
435:         self, question: str, plan: Dict[str, Any], evidence: Dict[str, Any]
436:     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
437:         """Use GPT-4.1 to write a grounded, cited answer from ``evidence``.
438: 
439:         Returns ``{"answer": str, "used_sources": list[str]}``. When the
440:         evidence is empty or truncated, returns an explicit insufficiency answer
441:         with no citations instead of fabricating content.
442:         """
443:         language = (plan or {}).get("target_language") or detect_language(question)
444:         items = evidence.get("items") if isinstance(evidence, dict) else None
445:         if not items or evidence.get("truncated"):
446:             return {
447:                 "answer": _insufficient_answer(language),
448:                 "used_sources": [],
449:                 "insufficient": True,
450:             }
451: 
452:         lines, source_map = _format_evidence(items)
453:         user_block = (
454:             f"Original question: {question}\n"
455:             f"Research plan: {json.dumps(plan or {}, ensure_ascii=False)}\n"
456:             f"Target language: {language}\n"
457:             f"Evidence items:\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n\n"
458:             "Write the final answer now, in the target language, citing evidence "
459:             "ids such as [S1] for every verifiable factual claim."
460:         )
461:         messages = [
462:             {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT_RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS},
463:             {"role": "user", "content": user_block},
464:         ]
465:         try:
466:             response = self.research_llm.get_chat_completion_sync(
467:                 messages=messages, temperature=0.2, max_tokens=2000
468:             )
469:             raw_answer = _extract_content(response).strip()
470:         except Exception as exc:  # missing method, network error, etc.
471:             return {
472:                 "answer": _insufficient_answer(language),
473:                 "used_sources": [],
474:                 "insufficient": True,
475:                 "error": f"synthesis call failed: {exc}",
476:             }
477: 
478:         if not raw_answer:
479:             return {
480:                 "answer": _insufficient_answer(language),
481:                 "used_sources": [],
482:                 "insufficient": True,
483:                 "error": "empty synthesis response",
484:             }
485: 
486:         answer = _sanitize_citations(raw_answer, set(source_map))
487:         used_sources: List[str] = []
488:         for match in _CITATION_RE.finditer(answer):
489:             sid = f"S{match.group(1)}"
490:             if sid in source_map and sid not in used_sources:
491:                 used_sources.append(sid)
492:         return {"answer": answer, "used_sources": used_sources}
493: 
494:     def run(self, question: str, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
495:         """Plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and return an answer plus trace."""
496:         plan = self._plan_research(question, metadata)
497:         steps: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [
498:             {"t": time.time(), "action": "plan", "detail": question}
499:         ]
500:         evidence = self._gather_evidence(plan, steps)
501: 
502:         synthesis_trace: Dict[str, Any] = {
503:             "system_prompt": "SYSTEM_PROMPT_RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS",
504:             "system_prompt_chars": len(SYSTEM_PROMPT_RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS),
505:             "model": self.research_model_name,
506:             "language": plan.get("target_language") or detect_language(question),
507:             "evidence_ids": [f"S{i}" for i in range(1, len(evidence.get("items") or []) + 1)],
508:             "used_sources": [],
509:             "grounded": False,
510:         }
511: 
512:         must_search = bool(plan.get("must_search")) or self.must_use_search
513:         if must_search and evidence["search_successes"] == 0:
514:             answer = RETRIEVAL_FAILURE_ANSWER
515:             synthesis_trace["status"] = "retrieval_failure"
516:         else:
517:             synthesis = self._synthesize_answer(question, plan, evidence)
518:             answer = synthesis["answer"]
519:             synthesis_trace["used_sources"] = synthesis.get("used_sources", [])
520:             synthesis_trace["grounded"] = bool(synthesis.get("used_sources"))
521:             if synthesis.get("insufficient"):
522:                 synthesis_trace["status"] = "insufficient"
523:             elif synthesis.get("error"):
524:                 synthesis_trace["status"] = "error"
525:                 synthesis_trace["error"] = synthesis["error"]
526:             else:
527:                 synthesis_trace["status"] = "ok"
528: 
529:         trace = {
530:             "models": {
531:                 "research": self.research_model_name,
532:                 "browsing": self.browsing_model_name,
533:             },
534:             "tools": {
535:                 "search_engine": type(self.search_tool).__name__,
536:                 "browsing_agent": type(self.browsing_agent).__name__,
537:                 "search_available": self.search_tool is not None,
538:                 "browsing_available": self.browsing_agent is not None,
539:                 "must_use_search": self.must_use_search,
540:             },
541:             "max_research_time_s": self.max_research_time_s,
542:             "metadata": metadata or {},
543:             "plan": plan,
544:             "evidence": evidence,
545:             "steps": steps,
546:             "synthesis": synthesis_trace,
547:         }
548:         return {
549:             "answer": answer,
550:             "trace": trace,
551:             "language": detect_language(question),
552:         }

3: from typing import Optional
4: import argparse

6: from litellm import batch_completion, _turn_on_debug, ModelResponse
7: from loguru import logger
8: 
9: 
10: VERIFICATION_PROMPT_TEMPLATE = """
11: Make a verification on whether the following response to the question is correct or not based on the ground truth answer.
12: 
13: Here is the question: 
14: <question>
15: {question}
16: </question>
17: 
18: Here is the response:
19: <response>
20: {response}
21: </response>
22: 
23: Here is the ground truth answer:
24: <ground_truth_answer>
25: {ground_truth_answer}
26: </ground_truth_answer>
27: 
28: 
29: Criteria for correctness:
30: - When the exact answer in the response is the same as the ground truth answer regardless of the format, the response is correct.
31: - For numerical answers, the response is correct if the exact answer in the response is within a small margin of the ground truth answer.
32: 
33: You should first think carefully for the correctness of the response.
34: 
35: You should output the verification result in the following format, and the result should be one of ["correct", "incorrect"]:
36: <verification_result>
37: ( your verification result here, should be correct or incorrect )
38: </verification_result>
39: """.strip()
40: 
41: 
42: def get_content_from_tag(
43:     content: str,
44:     tag: str,
45:     default_value: Optional[str] = None
46: ) -> Optional[str]:
47:     """
48:     extract the content from the first specified tag
49:     """
50:     if not content:
51:         return default_value
52: 
53:     pattern = rf"<{tag}>(.*?)(?=(</{tag}>|<\w+|$))"
54:     match = re.search(pattern, content, re.DOTALL)
55:     if match:
56:         return match.group(1).strip()
57:     return default_value
58: 
59: 
60: def main():
61:     dev_gt = json.load(open("/workspace/data/datasets/dev.json"))
62:     dev_pred = json.load(open("/workspace/data/outputs/dev.json"))
63: 
64:     batch_size = 10
65:     correct_count = 0
66: 
67:     for i in range(0, len(dev_gt), batch_size):
68:         batch_gt = dev_gt[i:i+batch_size]
69:         batch_pred = dev_pred[i:i+batch_size]
70: 
71:         batch_question = [item_gt["prompt"] for item_gt in batch_gt]
72: 
73:         batch_gt = [item_gt["answer"] for item_gt in batch_gt]
74:         batch_pred = [item_pred["answer"] for item_pred in batch_pred]
75: 
76:         batch_prompt = [VERIFICATION_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(
77:             question=question,
78:             response=response,
79:             ground_truth_answer=gt
80:         ) for question, response, gt in zip(batch_question, batch_pred, batch_gt)]
81: 
82:         batch_response = batch_completion(
83:             model="azure/o3", # o3 or azure/o3
84:             messages=[[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}] for prompt in batch_prompt],
85:             temperature=1, 
86:             max_tokens=1000,
87:             api_key="",
88:             api_version="",
89:             api_base="",
90:         )
91: 
92:         for res in batch_response:
93:             if res and isinstance(res, ModelResponse):
94:                 verification_result = get_content_from_tag(res.choices[0].message.content, "verification_result")
95:                 if verification_result:
96:                     if "correct" in verification_result.lower() and "incorrect" not in verification_result.lower():
97:                         correct_count += 1
98:             else:
99:                 raise ValueError(f"Error in verification: {res}")

"""End-to-end entry point for the deep research agent (subtask 5).

Reads a dataset split, runs ``ResearchAgent`` on each prompt, and writes
predictions in the evaluation format. Only stdlib is imported at module load so
the wiring can be imported by tests without pulling in heavy ML/network deps;
those are imported lazily inside :func:`build_agent`.

Configuration is read from environment variables:
    OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL (or AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY /
    AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT / AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION), SERPER_API_KEY.
    WORKSPACE_ROOT overrides the default ``/workspace`` root.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT = "/workspace"
SAFE_ERROR_ANSWER = (
    "The research agent could not produce an answer for this question."
)


def workspace_root() -> Path:
    return Path(os.environ.get("WORKSPACE_ROOT", DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ROOT))


def dataset_path(split: str, root: Optional[Path] = None) -> Path:
    root = Path(root) if root is not None else workspace_root()
    return root / "datasets" / f"{split}.json"


def output_path(split: str, root: Optional[Path] = None) -> Path:
    root = Path(root) if root is not None else workspace_root()
    if split == "dev":
        return root / "outputs" / "dev_predictions.json"
    return root / "outputs" / "test.json"


def load_examples(split: str, root: Optional[Path] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    with open(dataset_path(split, root), "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return json.load(handle)


def build_agent():
    """Wire the real clients/tools from environment configuration.

    Heavy (network/ML) imports happen here so importing this module is cheap.
    """
    from agents.browsing_agent import WebBrowsingAgent
    from agents.research_agent import ResearchAgent
    from services.llm_service import LLMService
    from toolkit.search_engine_tool import SearchEngineTool

    openai_key = [secret redacted]
    openai_base = os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL", "")
    azure_key = [secret redacted]
    azure_endpoint = os.environ.get("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT", "")
    azure_version = os.environ.get("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION", "2024-05-01-preview")
    serper_key = [secret redacted]

    if azure_key or azure_endpoint:
        [secret redacted]
            "azure",
            azure_key,
            azure_endpoint,
            azure_version,
        )
    else:
        provider, api_key, base_url, api_version = [secret redacted]

    # Model policy: GPT-4.1 for research/synthesis, GPT-4.1-mini for browsing.
    research_llm = LLMService("gpt-4.1", api_key, base_url, provider, api_version)
    browsing_llm = LLMService("gpt-4.1-mini", api_key, base_url, provider, api_version)

    config = {
        "serper_api_key": [secret redacted]
        "agent_model": {
            "name": "gpt-4.1",
            "api_key": [secret redacted]
            "base_url": base_url,
            "provider": provider,
            "api_version": api_version,
        },
        "web_browsing_model": {
            "name": "gpt-4.1-mini",
            "api_key": [secret redacted]
            "base_url": base_url,
            "provider": provider,
            "api_version": api_version,
        },
    }

    search_tool = SearchEngineTool(config)
    browsing_agent = WebBrowsingAgent(config)
    return ResearchAgent(research_llm, browsing_llm, search_tool, browsing_agent)


def run_examples(agent, examples: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """Run the agent on each example, preserving order and prompt text exactly."""
    results: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
    for example in examples:
        prompt = example.get("prompt", "")
        try:
            outcome = agent.run(prompt, {})
            answer = outcome.get("answer") or SAFE_ERROR_ANSWER
        except Exception:  # never let one bad item break the whole run
            answer = SAFE_ERROR_ANSWER
        results.append({"prompt": prompt, "answer": answer})
    return results


def write_outputs(
    results: List[Dict[str, str]], split: str, root: Optional[Path] = None
) -> Path:
    root = Path(root) if root is not None else workspace_root()
    target = output_path(split, root)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(results, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    # Mirror dev predictions to the path expected by scripts/eval_on_dev.py.
    if split == "dev":
        mirror = root / "data" / "outputs" / "dev.json"
        mirror.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(mirror, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            json.dump(results, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    return target


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run the deep research agent.")
    parser.add_argument("--split", required=True, choices=["dev", "test"])
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    examples = load_examples(args.split)
    agent = build_agent()
    results = run_examples(agent, examples)
    target = write_outputs(results, args.split)
    print(f"Wrote {len(results)} {args.split} predictions to {target}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""End-to-end integration test for the research agent pipeline (subtask 5).

Runnable directly (``python scripts/test_end_to_end.py``) or via pytest. Builds
the agent with mock clients/tools, runs a small synthetic dataset through the
same code path as ``main.py``, and verifies output format, ordering, mandatory
search usage, model restriction, policy guards, and the time budget.

Only stdlib is used.
"""

import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "repositories" / "deep_research_agent"
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts"))

import main as main_module  # noqa: E402
import agents.research_agent as ra  # noqa: E402
from agents.research_agent import ResearchAgent  # noqa: E402


class _Message:
    def __init__(self, content):
        self.content = content


class _Choice:
    def __init__(self, content):
        self.message = _Message(content)


class _Response:
    def __init__(self, content):
        self.choices = [_Choice(content)]


class MockLLM:
    def __init__(self, model_name, payload):
        self.model_name = model_name
        self.payload = payload

    def get_chat_completion_sync(self, messages, **kwargs):
        return _Response(self.payload)


class CountingSearchTool:
    """Counts search invocations per query string."""

    def __init__(self, duplicate=False):
        self.calls = []
        self.duplicate = duplicate

    def search(self, query):
        self.calls.append(query)
        if self.duplicate:
            urls = ["https://ex.com/a", "https://ex.com/b"]
        else:
            urls = [f"https://ex.com/{abs(hash(query)) % 997}"]
        return [
            {"url": u, "title": f"Title {u}", "snippet": f"Snippet for {query}"}
            for u in urls
        ]


class CountingBrowseAgent:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def browse(self, url, query, language):
        self.calls.append((url, query, language))
        return f"Extracted content for {url} ({language})"


_PLAN = {
    "target_language": "en",
    "subquestions": [
        "search the web for the background of the topic",
        "what are the key facts and figures",
    ],
    "expected_answer_type": "short_fact",
    "must_search": True,
}

_POLICY_PLAN = {
    "target_language": "en",
    "subquestions": ['search "/workspace/datasets/dev.json" for the raw answers'],
    "expected_answer_type": "short_fact",
    "must_search": True,
}


def _build_agent(plan_payload, search_tool=None, browse_agent=None, **kwargs):
    return ResearchAgent(
        MockLLM("gpt-4.1", json.dumps(plan_payload)),
        MockLLM("gpt-4.1-mini", ""),
        search_tool or CountingSearchTool(),
        browse_agent or CountingBrowseAgent(),
        **kwargs,
    )


def _write_dataset(root, split, items):
    path = root / "datasets" / f"{split}.json"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(items, handle, ensure_ascii=False)


def test_output_format_order_and_prompts_preserved():
    examples = [
        {"prompt": "What are the main applications of CRISPR in agriculture?"},
        {"prompt": "\u89e3\u91ca\u91cf\u5b50\u7ea0\u7f20\u5728\u91cf\u5b50\u901a\u4fe1\u4e2d\u7684\u4f5c\u7528"},
        {"prompt": "Explain the causes of the 2008 financial crisis in detail."},
        {"prompt": "Who won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics?"},
    ]

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        _write_dataset(root, "test", examples)

        agent = _build_agent(_PLAN)
        main_module.build_agent = lambda: agent  # bypass heavy construction

        old_root = os.environ.get("WORKSPACE_ROOT")
        os.environ["WORKSPACE_ROOT"] = str(root)
        try:
            rc = main_module.main(["--split", "test"])
        finally:
            if old_root is None:
                os.environ.pop("WORKSPACE_ROOT", None)
            else:
                os.environ["WORKSPACE_ROOT"] = old_root
        assert rc == 0

        out_file = root / "outputs" / "test.json"
        assert out_file.exists(), "test.json output must exist"
        outputs = json.loads(out_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert isinstance(outputs, list)
        assert len(outputs) == len(examples)
        for i, item in enumerate(outputs):
            assert item["prompt"] == examples[i]["prompt"], "prompt/order preserved"
            assert isinstance(item["answer"], str) and item["answer"]

        # dev split writes dev_predictions.json + eval-compatible mirror.
        _write_dataset(root, "dev", examples)
        main_module.write_outputs(outputs, "dev", root)
        assert (root / "outputs" / "dev_predictions.json").exists()
        assert (root / "data" / "outputs" / "dev.json").exists()


def test_search_called_at_least_once_per_question():
    questions = [
        "What are the main applications of CRISPR in agriculture?",
        "\u89e3\u91ca\u91cf\u5b50\u7ea0\u7f20\u5728\u91cf\u5b50\u901a\u4fe1\u4e2d\u7684\u4f5c\u7528",
    ]
    for question in questions:
        search = CountingSearchTool()
        agent = _build_agent(_PLAN, search_tool=search)
        agent.run(question, {})
        assert len(search.calls) >= 1, "search must be called at least once"


def test_model_restriction():
    search = CountingSearchTool()
    agent = _build_agent(_PLAN, search_tool=search)
    assert agent.research_model_name == "gpt-4.1"
    assert agent.browsing_model_name == "gpt-4.1-mini"


def test_dataset_path_guard_blocks_and_logs():
    search = CountingSearchTool()
    agent = _build_agent(_POLICY_PLAN, search_tool=search)
    result = agent.run("Reveal the raw dataset answers.", {})

    trace = result["trace"]
    assert trace["policy_violations"], "violation must be logged in the trace"
    assert "policy violation" in result["answer"].lower()
    assert search.calls == [], "protected dataset search must not be executed"


def test_time_budget_aborts_and_marks_truncated():
    search = CountingSearchTool()
    browse = CountingBrowseAgent()
    agent = _build_agent(_PLAN, search_tool=search, browse_agent=browse)
    agent.max_research_time_s = 250.0

    class Clock:
        def __init__(self):
            self.t = 0.0

        def time(self):
            self.t += 100.0
            return self.t

    original = ra.time
    ra.time = Clock()
    try:
        result = agent.run("A very long research question", {})
    finally:
        ra.time = original

    evidence = result["trace"]["evidence"]
    assert evidence["truncated"] is True
    assert evidence["search_calls"] < len(_PLAN["subquestions"])
    lowered = result["answer"].lower()
    assert "time budget" in lowered or "partial research" in lowered


def test_max_research_time_capped_at_600():
    agent = _build_agent(_PLAN, max_research_time_s=100000.0)
    assert agent.max_research_time_s == 600.0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_output_format_order_and_prompts_preserved()
    test_search_called_at_least_once_per_question()
    test_model_restriction()
    test_dataset_path_guard_blocks_and_logs()
    test_time_budget_aborts_and_marks_truncated()
    test_max_research_time_capped_at_600()
    print("end-to-end integration tests passed")
